Measured 2026-11-18 against the real library (38,397 Supreme Court judgments; 2,335 statute sections), commit after 291d8c0.
Rebuild the set: node --import tsx scripts/build-gold.ts   Re-measure: node --import tsx scripts/eval-library.ts

Known limits of the library, found while measuring:
- 96 INSC numbers are carried by more than one record (216 records, 0.56%); a citation using one of them comes back
  "partial / ambiguous", never verified. Cause appears to be errors in the source metadata.
- SCC, AIR, SCC OnLine, SCALE and High Court neutral citations are "not covered": the source holds INSC and SCR only.
- CrPC and CPC sections currently verify only from hand-typed seed rows with no official source; Phase 3 replaces them.
- The Constitution and SC/ST Act are not loaded.
